checks.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 rustup run stable cargo bake --locked test:coverage --package core-markdown --all-targets true --all-features true
CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 rustup run stable cargo bake --locked test

notes: The first coverage run overlapped a comment-only source edit and failed to map source columns; a complete rerun on unchanged final source passed.
